8.2.1.v: Whatever will be taught hereafter, up to the end of the work, is to be considered as not taken effect, in relation to the application of a preceding rule.
8.2.1.e: The rules defined in त्रिपादी are non existent with-respect-to the rules of सपादसप्ताध्यायी. Even within त्रिपादी, the later rules are non existent with-respect-to the former rules.
8.2.1.sa: सपादसप्ताध्यायीम् प्रति त्रिपादी असिद्धा वर्तते । त्रिपाद्याम् अपि पूर्वम् शास्त्रम् प्रति परम् शास्त्रम् असिद्धम् वर्तते ।
8.2.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.2.v: The elision of a final न् -- नलोपः प्रातिपदिकान्तस्य [[8.2.7]], is considered as if not to have taken effect, in applying the following rules - 1. rules regarding case-endings 2. rules regarding accents 3. rules regarding any technical term of Grammar and 4. rules regarding the augment त् before a कृत् affix.
8.2.2.e: The नकारलोप given by 'न लोपः प्रातिपदिकान्तस्य' is असिद्ध only with reference to (1) सुप्-विधि, (2) स्वरविधि, (3) संज्ञाविधि, and (4) तुगागम caused by a कृत्-प्रत्यय.
8.2.2.sa: नकारलोपः केवलं सुप्-विधौ, स्वरविधौ, संज्ञाविधौ, तथा कृति-तुक्-विधौ एव असिद्धः अस्ति, न अन्यत्र ।
8.2.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.3.v: The sūtra अदसोऽसेर्दादु दो मः [[8.2.80]], teaching the substitution of मु for the दस् of the pronoun अदस् is however not treated as असिद्ध in relation to the case-ending ना।
8.2.3.e: The मु  आदेश is not considered असिद्ध while and after doing the 'ना' आदेश.
8.2.3.sa: 'मु' इति आदेशः 'ना' इति आदेशे कर्तव्ये, तस्मिन् आदेशे कृते च असिद्धः नास्ति ।
8.2.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.4.v: A स्वरित vowel is the substitute of an अनुदात्त vowel when the latter follows after such a semi-vowel which has replaced an उदात्त (acute accent) or a स्वरित vowel.

8.2.5.v: The single substitute of an unaccented with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel is उदात्त।

8.2.6.v: The single substitute of an unaccented vowel standing at the beginning of a word, with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel may optionally be a स्वरित or उदात्त (acute accent).

8.2.7.v: The न् at the end of a nominal-stem, which is a पद -- शेषो घ्यसखि [[1.4.7]], is elided.
8.2.7.e: The terminal न् letter of a प्रातिपदिक is omitted if the प्रातिपदिक also gets the पदसंंज्ञा.
8.2.7.sa: प्रातिपदिकसंज्ञकम् यत् पदम् तदन्तस्य नकारस्य लोपः स्यात् ।
8.2.7.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.8.v: (But such न्) is not elided in the Locative -7th case and Vocative Case singular.
8.2.8.e:
For a प्रातिपदिक that also gets the पदसंंज्ञा, the terminal न् letter is not omitted in presence of the      
ङि or सम्बुद्धि प्रत्यय.
8.2.8.sa: प्रातिपदिकान्तम् यत् पदम्, तदन्तस्य नकारस्य ङि-प्रत्यये परे सम्बुद्धि-प्रत्यये च परे लोपः न भवति ।
8.2.8.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.9.v: For the म् of the affix मत् is substituted व if the अङ्ग (stem) ends in म् or अ ( and आ) or if these are in the penultimate position; but not after यव etc.

8.2.10.v: The व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a mute consonant.

8.2.11.v: The व् is substituted for the म् of मत् when the word so formed is a Name.

8.2.12.v: The following names are irregularly formed 1. आसन्दीवत् 2. अष्ठीवत् 3. चक्रीवत् 4. कक्षीवत् 5. रुमण्वत् and 6. चर्मण्वती। (Reference श्लोक - आसन्दीवति धान्यादं रुक्मिणं हरितस्रजम्। अश्वं बबन्ध सारङ्गं देवेभ्यो अनमेजयः।)

8.2.13.v: The word उदन्वान् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'a sea'.

8.2.14.v: Also राजन्वान् when the sense is of a good government.

8.2.15.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इ (or ई) or र्।

8.2.16.v: The affix मत् gets the augment नुट् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन्।

8.2.17.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affixes तर and तम get the augment नुट् after a stem in न्।

8.2.18.v: For the र् of the root कृप् there is substituted ल्।

8.2.19.v: ल् is substituted for the र् of a preposition when अयते follows.

8.2.20.v: ल् is substituted for the र् of गॄ in the intensive.

8.2.21.v: र् is optionally changed to ल् before an affix beginning with a vowel.

8.2.22.v: The र् of परि is changed to ल् before घ and अङ्क।

8.2.23.v: When a word ends in a double consonant the last consonant is dropped.
8.2.23.e: The last letter of a पद that ends in a संयोग is removed.
8.2.23.sa: यस्य पदस्य अन्ते संयोगः विद्यते तस्य पदस्य अन्तिमवर्णस्य लोपः भवति ।
8.2.23.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.24.v: Of a word ending in a conjunct consonant, only स् is elided if it comes after र् (but any other consonant coming after र् is not elided).
8.2.24.e: For a संयोग occurring at end of a पद which contains रेफ as the first letter, the last letter is deleted only if it is a सकार and not otherwise.
8.2.24.sa: पदान्ते विद्यमाने संयोगे रेफः विद्यते चेत् रेफात् परस्य केवलम् पदान्तसकारस्य एव लोपः भवति, अन्यवर्णस्य न ।
8.2.24.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.25.v: The स् is elided before an affix beginning with ध।

8.2.26.v: The स् is elided when it is preceded by a झल् consonant (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) and is followed by an affix beginning with a झल् consonant.

8.2.27.v: The स् is elided before an affix beginning with झल् consonant (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) when it is preceded by a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a short vowel.

8.2.28.v: The स् is elided after the augment इट् if after this स् the augment ईट् follows.

8.2.29.v: The स् or क् , when initial in a conjunct consonant, are elided before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) affix and at the end of a word.
8.2.29.e: If there is a संयोगः at end of a पद, or if there is a संयोगः which is followed by a झल्-वर्ण,  and if the first letter of that संयोगः is either स् or क् , then this letter is deleted.
8.2.29.sa: यः संयोगः पदस्य अन्ते उत झल्-वर्णात् अव्यवहितरूपेण पूर्वं विद्यते, तस्य आदिस्थस्य सकारस्य ककारस्य च लोपः भवति ।
8.2.29.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.30.v: A Guttural is substituted for a palatal before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) affix or at the end of a word.
8.2.30.e: A चवर्गीय letter which occurs at the end of a पद or before झल् letter is converted to the corresponding कवर्गीय letter.
8.2.30.sa: चवर्गीयवर्णस्य पदान्ते उत झल्-वर्णे परे कवर्गादेशः भवति ।
8.2.30.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.31.v: ढ is substituted for ह before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter and at the end of a word.
8.2.31.e: A  हकार is converted to a ढकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.
8.2.31.sa: हकारस्य  पदान्ते झलि परे वा ढकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.31.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.32.v: Of a root beginning with द , the ध is substituted for ह before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter or at the end of a word.
8.2.32.e: A हकार occurring at end of a दकारादि-धातु is converted to a घकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.
8.2.32.sa: दकारादि-धातोः अन्तिमहकारस्य पदान्ते झल्-वर्णे वा परे घकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.32.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.33.v: The ह of 1. द्रुह् 2. मुह् 3.ष्णुह् and 4. ष्णिह् is optionally changed to ध before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter or at the end of a word.
8.2.33.e: A हकार occurring at end of verbs द्रुहँ, मुहँ, ष्णुहँ and ष्णिहँ   at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter is converted optionally to a घकार.
8.2.33.sa: द्रुहँ, मुहँ, ष्णुहँ तथा ष्णिहँ - एतेषांं धातूनाम् हकारस्य पदान्ते झलि परे वा विकल्पेन घकारादेशः भवति, घकारादेशाभावे औत्सर्गिकः ढकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.33.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.34.v: The ह of नह् is changed to ध before a before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter or at the end of a word.
8.2.34.e: The हकार for the verb नह् is converted to धकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.
8.2.34.sa: नह्-धातोः अन्तिमहकारस्य पदान्ते झल्-वर्णे वा परे धकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.34.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.35.v: For the ह of the root आह् there is substituted थ before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter.
8.2.35.e: The हकार of 'आह्' is converted to थकार when followed by a झल् letter.
8.2.35.sa: 'आह्' इत्यस्य हकारस्य झलि परे थकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.35.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.36.v: For the final consonants of 1. व्रश्च् 2. भ्रस्ज् 3. सृज् 4. मृज् 5. यज् 6. राज् and 7. भ्राज् and for the final छ and श , there is substituted ष् or at the end of a word.
8.2.36.e: The laster letter of the word व्रश्च्, भ्रस्ज्, सृज्, मृज्, यज्, राज्, भ्राज् and  शकारान्त /  च्छकारान्त words gets षकारादेश at पदान्त, or when झल् letter is in front.
8.2.36.sa: व्रश्च्, भ्रस्ज्, सृज्, मृज्, यज्, राज्, भ्राज् -  एतेषां शब्दानाम् , शकारान्तशब्दानाम् छकारान्तशब्दानाम् च झलि परे तथा च पदान्ते षकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.36.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.37.v: For the letters 1. ब 2. ग 3. ड or 4. द in the beginning of a mono-syllable and belonging to a root, and which ends in 1. झ 2. भ 3. घ 4. ढ or 5. ध there is substituted 1. भ 2. घ 3. ढ or 4. ध respectively before स् or ध्व or at the end of a word.
8.2.37.e: A बश्-वर्ण of an एकाच् and झषन्त part of a verb is converted to a भष् वर्ण - (1) in presence of a सकार, (2) in presence of a  the word ध्व, or (3) at end of a पद
8.2.37.sa: धातोः यः एकाच् झषन्तः अवयवः, तस्य बश्-वर्णस्य, पदान्ते, सकारे, ध्व-शब्दे वा परे भष्-स्यात् ।
8.2.37.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.38.v: For the द of दध (the reduplicated form of धा) is substituted ध before the affixes beginning with त, थ, स and before ध्वम्।
8.2.38.e: The बश्-letter of the the झषन्त-एकाच्-अवयव present in the 'दध्' form of the verb root 'धा' is converted to a corresponding भष् letter when followed by  तकार, थकार, सकार, or the word ध्व.
8.2.38.sa: धा-धातोः 'दध्' इत्यस्य रूपस्य झषन्तस्य एकाच्-अवयवस्य बश्-वर्णस्य  तकारे, थकारे, सकारे, ध्वप्रत्यये च परे  भष् भवति ।
8.2.38.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.39.v: A corresponding ज, ब, ग, ड or द is substituted for all consonants (with the exception of semi-vowels and nasals) at the end of a word.
8.2.39.e: A झल् letter occurring at end of a पद is converted to the corresponding जश् letter.
8.2.39.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.40.v: ध is substituted for त or थ coming after झष् (झ, भ, घ, ढ, ध) but not after the root धा (दध).
8.2.40.e: The तकार and थकार that follows a झष् letter is converted to  धकार. But this conversion does not happen for the verb  root 'धा'.
8.2.40.sa: धा-धातुं विहाय अन्येषाम् धातूनाम् विषये झष्-वर्णात् परस्य तकारस्य थकारस्य च धकारः भवति ।
8.2.40.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.41.v: क is substituted for ष or ढ before स।
8.2.41.e: षकार and  ढकार not occurring at end of a पद are converted to  ककार when followed by सकार.
8.2.41.sa: षकारस्य ढकारस्य च सकारे परे ककारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.41.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.42.v: After र and द for the त of the Participial suffix त and तवत् there is substituted न and the same substitution takes place also for the preceding द।

8.2.43.v: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after a root ending in आ and commencing with a conjunct consonant, if the latter contains a semi-vowel.

8.2.44.v: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after the roots लू and those that follow it.

8.2.45.v: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after a root which has an indicatory ओ in the धातुपाठ।

8.2.46.v: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after क्षि when the root-vowel is lengthened.

8.2.47.v: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after श्यै but not when the participle denotes 'cold'.

8.2.48.v: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after अञ्च् but not when it is in connection with an Ablative -5th case.

8.2.49.v: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after दिव् when the sense is not that of 'play'.

8.2.50.v: The word निर्वाण is irregularly formed by changing the निष्ठा त is changed to न when the sense is not that of 'wind'.

8.2.51.v: क is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root शुष्।

8.2.52.v: व is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root पच् 'to cook' ।

8.2.53.v: म is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root क्षै।

8.2.54.v: म is optionally substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root स्तयै preceded by प्र।

8.2.55.v: The irregular participles 1. फुल्ल 2. क्षीब 3. कृश and 4. उल्लाघ are formed then only, when no preposition precedes them.

8.2.56.v: The निष्ठा त is optionally changed to न after 1. नुद 2. विद 3. उन्द 4. त्रा 5. घ्रा and 6. ह्री।

8.2.57.v: The निष्ठा त is not changed to न after 1. ध्या 2. ख्या 3. पॄ 4. मूर्छि and 5. मद।

8.2.58.v: The irregularly formed participle वित्त denotes 'possessions' and 'renowned'.

8.2.59.v: The word भित्त is irregularly formed in the sense of 'a fragment, a portion'.

8.2.60.v: The word ऋण is irregularly formed in the sense of 'debt.

8.2.61.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) we have the following irregular participles - 1. नसत्त 2. निषत्त 3. अनुत्त 4. प्रतूर्त 5. सूर्त्त and 6. गूर्त्त।

8.2.62.v: A अङ्ग (stem) formed with the affix क्विन् under स्पृशोऽनुदके क्विन् [[3.2.58]] etc. substitutes, at the end of a word, a guttural for the final consonant.
8.2.62.e: The word ending in a क्विन्-प्रत्यय gets a कवर्गादेश at पदान्त ।
8.2.62.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.63.v: The final नश् at the end of a word is optionally changed to guttural.
8.2.63.e: The word नश् undergoes an optional कुत्वम् at पदान्त.
8.2.63.sa: नश् (=नश्वरः) शब्दस्य पदान्ते विकल्पेन कुवर्गादेशः (गकारः) भवति ।
8.2.63.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.64.v: न is substituted, at the end of a word, for the final म of a root.
8.2.64.e: A मकार occurring at end of a धातु which in turn occurs at end of a पद is converted to नकार.
8.2.64.sa: धातोः पदान्ते विद्यमानस्य मकारस्य नकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.64.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.65.v: न is substituted for the म of a root before the affixes beginning with म and व।

8.2.66.v: For the final स् and for the ष् of ससजुष् is substituted रु , at the end of a word.
8.2.66.e: The सकार at end of a पद, and the षकार at end of the सजुष् पद get a रुँ-आदेश ।
8.2.66.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.67.v: The same substitution takes place for the final Nominatives of 1. अवयाः 2. श्वेतवाः and 3. पुरोडाः।
8.2.67.e: The words अवयाः, श्वेतवाः, पुरोडाः are considered derived.
8.2.67.sa: अवयाः,  श्वेतवाः,  पुरोडाः - एते शब्दाः निपात्यन्ते ।
8.2.67.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.68.v: रु is also substituted for the न् of अहन् at the end of a word.
8.2.68.e: The word अहन् gets रुँत्व at पदान्त.
8.2.68.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.69.v: When no case-ending follows (i.e. at the end of a word, in the narrower sense), र् is substituted for the न् of अहन्।
8.2.69.e: The word अहन् gets रेफादेश at पदान्त, except when followed by a सुप्-प्रत्यय.
8.2.69.sa: अहन्-इत्यस्य नकारस्य पदान्ते रेफादेशः भवति, परन्तु सुप्-प्रत्यये परे न भवति ।
8.2.69.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.70.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), both रु and र् are substituted for the final 1. अमनस् 2. ऊधस् and 3. अवस्।

8.2.71.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), both रु and र् may replace the final of the word भुवस् when used as a महाव्याहृति।

8.2.72.v: द is substituted for the final स् of a word ending in the affix वस् and for the final of 1. स्रंस् 2. ध्वंस् and 3. अनडुह् at the end of a word (in the wider sense निपात एकाजनाङ् [[1.1.14]], उञः [[1.1.17]]).
8.2.72.e: The सकारान्त वसुँ-प्रत्ययान्तशब्द, स्रंसु-शब्द, ध्वंसु-शब्द and अनडुह्-शब्द get a दकारादेशः at पदान्त.
8.2.72.sa: वसुँ-प्रत्ययान्तस्य सकारान्तशब्दस्य, स्रंसु-शब्दस्य, ध्वंसु-शब्दस्य तथा अनडुह्-शब्दस्य पदान्ते दकारादेशः भवति ।
8.2.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.73.v: द is substituted for the final स् of a root with the exception of अस् 'to be' , before the personal ending ति (त्) when it stands at the end of a word.

8.2.74.v: द् or रु may optionally be substituted for the स् of a root, , before the personal ending सि (स्) when such स् stands at the end of a word.

8.2.75.v: द् or रु may optionally be substituted for the द् of a root, , before the personal ending सि (स्) when such द् stands at the end of a word.

8.2.76.v: A penultimate इ or उ is lengthened, when the र् or व् of a root can stand at the end of a word.
8.2.76.e: The उपधा letter of a रेफान्त or a वकारान्त पद which also has a धातुसंज्ञा becomes दीर्घ if that letter belongs to the इक् प्रत्याहार.
8.2.76.sa: रेफान्तस्य वकारान्तस्य धातोः पदस्य उपधाभूतस्य इक्-वर्णस्य दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
8.2.76.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.77.v: Of a root ending in र् or व् , the penultimate इ or उ is lengthened before a consonantal beginning affix.
8.2.77.e: The उपधा letter of a रेफान्त or a वकारान्त धातु becomes दीर्घ if that letter belongs to the इक् प्रत्याहार and if the धातु is followed by a हल् letter.
8.2.77.sa: रेफ-वकारान्त-धातोः उपधाभूतस्य इक्-वर्णस्य हल्-वर्णे परे दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
8.2.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.78.v: The short इ or उ is lengthened, when the verb has र् or व् as its penultimate letter and is followed by a consonant.
8.2.78.e: When a धातु has (1)  a हल्-letter at the end (2) a रेफ / वकार in the second-last position, and (3) an इक् letter in the third-last position, then the इक् letter undergoes a दीर्घादेश.
8.2.78.sa: धातोः उपधाभूतौ हल्परौ यौ रेफवकारौ, ताभ्याम् पूर्वस्य इक्-वर्णस्य दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
8.2.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.79.v: The lengthening of a vowel does not take place under हलि च [[8.2.77]] when the nominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in र् or व् is called भ (i.e. when a य् follows) and also not in कुर् and छुर्।

8.2.80.v: When the सर्वनाम अदस् does not end in स् then there is substituted उ or ऊ for the vowel after द् , and म् for द्।

8.2.81.v: For the ए coming after the द् of अदस् , there is substituted ई , and द् is changed to म् when plurality is to be expressed.

8.2.82.v: Up to the close of this chapter (पाद), is always to be supplied the words 'the last vowel of a sentence is प्लुत and has the acute'.
8.2.82.e: In the context of all the सूत्राणि till the end of this पाद, the टि-संज्ञक स्वर of the sentence would be considered प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.82.sa: इतः परम् अस्य पादस्य अन्तिमं सूत्रपर्यन्तं निर्दिष्टेषु सन्दर्भेषु वाक्यस्य टि-संज्ञकः प्लुतः तथा उदात्तः भवति ।
8.2.82.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.83.v: In answer to a salutation, but not when it refers to शुद्र , the last vowel of a sentence becomes प्लुत and gets an acute accent (उदात्त).
8.2.83.e: The टिसंज्ञक of the sentence which is used to answer a greeting, becomes प्लुत  and उदात्त, provided that the sentence is not addressed to a शूद्र.
8.2.83.sa: शूद्रं विहाय अन्यान् प्रति अभिवादनस्य प्रत्युत्तरम् येन वाक्येन दीयते, तस्य टिसंज्ञकः प्लुतः उदात्तः च भवति ।
8.2.83.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.84.v: The final vowel of a sentence becomes प्लुत and acutely accented (उदात्त) when used in calling a person from a distance.
8.2.84.e: The टिसंज्ञक स्वर of the sentence used for calling someone from a distance becomes प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.84.sa: दूरात् सम्बोधनं कर्तुं यत् वाक्यम् उच्चार्यते, तस्य टिसंज्ञकः प्लुतः उदात्तः च भवति ।
8.2.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.85.v: When the words है and हे are used in addressing a person from a distance, there the है and हे alone get the प्लुत and the accent.
8.2.85.e: If the words हे / है are used in a sentence that is used for calling someone from a distance, then the स्वर of the only हे / है becomes प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.85.sa: 'है'/ 'हे' इति शब्दस्य प्रयोगं कृत्वा दूरात् सम्बोधनं कर्तुं यत् वाक्यम् उच्चार्यते, तस्मिन् वाक्ये 'है' / 'हे' शब्दस्य एव स्वरस्य प्लुतसंज्ञा, उदात्तसंज्ञा च भवति, न अन्यस्य ।
8.2.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.86.v: In the room of a prosodially long vowel (with the exception of ऋ) though it may not stand at the end, there is substituted a प्लुत for one at a time, under the above circumstances -- प्रत्यभिवादेशूद्रे [[8.2.83]] & दूराद्धूते च [[8.2.84]], in the opinion of Eastern Grammarians.
8.2.86.e: For the words whose टि has been mandated to be प्लुत and उदात्त by the earlier sutras, all the other ऋकारभिन्न गुरु letters of that word can also take turns one by one to become प्लुत and उदात्त, according to the experts of the east.
8.2.86.sa: यस्य शब्दस्य टिसंज्ञकस्य पूर्वसूत्रैः प्लुतत्वम् उदात्तत्वं च उच्यते, तस्मिन् शब्दे विद्यमानाः अन्ये ऋकारभिन्नाः गुरुसंज्ञकाः स्वराः प्राचां मतेन एकैकम् प्लुताः उदात्ताः भवन्ति ।
8.2.86.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.2.87.v: The vowel in ओम् is प्लुत in the beginning of a sacred text.

8.2.88.v: The vowel of ये becomes प्लुत in a sacred text when it is used in a sacrificial work.

8.2.89.v: In a sacrificial work ओ3म् is substituted for the final vowel with the consonant, if any, that may follow it, in a sentence.

8.2.90.v: The last vowel at the end of मन्त्र-s called याज्य , when used in sacrificial works is प्लुत and has the acute accent (उदात्त).

8.2.91.v: In a sacrificial work, the first syllable of 1. ब्रूहि 2. प्रेष्य 3. श्रौषट् and 4.आवह is प्लुत।

8.2.92.v: In an order given to अग्नीध्र priest, the first syllable as well as the succeeding syllable is प्लुत.

8.2.93.v: हि at the end of an answer to a question may optionally be प्लुत।

8.2.94.v: The end syllable of that sentence is optionally प्लुत when it asserts something which has been refuted and is used by the victor by way of censure.

8.2.95.v: The end syllable of an आम्रेडित Vocative Case is प्लुत when threat is expressed.

8.2.96.v: The final syllable of a finite verb used as a threat becomes प्लुत when the word अङ्ग is joined with it and it demands another sentence to complete the conclusion.

8.2.97.v: The end syllable of those sentences is प्लुत which denote acts of reflection (or balancing between two alternatives).

8.2.98.v: In the common speech, the end vowel of the first alternative is only प्लुत।

8.2.99.v: The end syllable of the sentence which expresses assent or promise or listening to, is प्लुत।

8.2.100.v: The end vowel at the end of a question or of a praise is प्लुत, but unaccented.

8.2.101.v: The end vowel at the end of a sentence becomes अनुदात्त and प्लुत when the particle चित् is used, denoting comparison.

8.2.102.v: In 1. उपरि 2. स्विद् and 3. आसीद् the end vowel is अनुदात्त and प्लुत।

8.2.103.v: Of the two Vocatives of the same form standing at the beginning of a sentence, the end vowel of the first becomes प्लुत and स्वरित when envy, praise, anger or blame is expressed.

8.2.104.v: When an error against polite usage is censured or when a benediction or a bidding is intended, the end syllable of a finite verb becomes प्लुत and स्वरित , if this requires another sentence to complete the sense.

8.2.105.v: In a question or narration, the end vowel of a word, though not final in a sentence, becomes प्लुत and स्वरित , as well as the word which is final in a sentence.

8.2.106.v: In forming the प्लुत of the diphthongs s ए and ओ , their last element इ and उ get the प्लुत।

8.2.107.v: In the diphthongs which are not प्रगृह्य -- ईदूदेद्द्विवचनं प्रगृह्यम् [[1.1.11]] etc. and which become प्लुत under the circumstances mentioned in प्रत्यभिवादेशूद्रे [[8.2.83]] etc., but not when that circumstance is a call from a distance -- दूराद्धूते च [[8.2.84]]; for the first half, there is substituted the prolated आ and for the second portion इ or उ।

8.2.108.v: For these vowels इ or उ are substituted य् and व् when a vowel follows them in a संहिता (in an unbroken flow of speech).
